prompt:
Create one new raster icon sheet for a children's educational game. The attached robot is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: friendly rounded shapes and especially its THIN dark navy outlines. Do not draw the robot or copy its AI lettering.
Canvas 1536x1024 landscape, 3 columns x 2 rows of equal square invisible cells, six item groups in reading order. Center each entire group in its cell, longest dimension about 75% of the cell. Same scale and same gentle 3/4 front view, showing front and right side. Plenty of transparent margin. No grid, tile backgrounds or borders.
Genuine fully transparent alpha background outside the objects. No backdrop, cast shadows, ground shadow, atmospheric glow, halos or stray pixels.
Rendering: CLEAN FLAT SOLID COLOR, very thin clean even dark-navy outlines, about 2px at this resolution, never thick sticker outlines. Smooth glossy cel shading made from exactly one uniform base tone, one discrete softer shadow tone, and one small solid highlight shape per material/color. Absolutely no gradients, texture, grain, mottling, washed-out or patchy fills. Few small details.
Limited whole-sheet palette: white/warm cream main bodies, one or two accents per icon drawn only from teal, coral, sunny yellow, sky blue. Dark navy for outlines, necessary wheels/screens/X-ray film. No other colors. Exceptions to cream bodies only as requested: teal tablet, coral band, sky-blue wheelchair frame.
NO text, NO letters, NO digits, NO AI anywhere. Each screen only one simple pictogram. No humans or hands.

Row1 col1 STUDY HELPER: simple teal tablet in 3/4 view, cream screen showing only a sunny yellow lightbulb pictogram. Rounded tablet, no other screen widgets, no extra bubble.
Row1 col2 NUTRITION KIOSK: small cream freestanding pedestal kiosk, teal screen displaying one tiny simple three-bar chart with no axes/labels/numbers; shelf beneath screen holding a compact lunch tray with simple cream bowl and small yellow/coral food shapes. Keep tray and kiosk one centered compact icon, few details.
Row1 col3 X-RAY READER: a navy X-ray film mounted on a white light panel. Film shows a simplified sky-blue ribcage silhouette, educational and non-graphic. One small sunny yellow corner bracket marks a single rib spot. No writing, no scan metadata or badges. Clearly a framed X-ray light panel.
Row2 col1 SMART BAND: coral wristband with a visible loop strap, small navy display with one white heartbeat zigzag line. No digits or extra buttons, minimal details.
Row2 col2 SMART WHEELCHAIR: recognizable empty wheelchair with sky-blue frame, cream seat and back, large rear wheels and small front caster wheels, armrests and footrests. Tiny teal sensor light on one armrest. Simple friendly design with just a few spokes, no person.
Row2 col3 ROAD SAFETY CCTV: white security camera attached near top of a simple cream pole, positioned above a small crosswalk represented by four cream parallel crossing stripes on a compact dark navy road patch. Whole pole-camera-crosswalk group stays inside its cell. Sky-blue camera lens accent, one small teal indicator. No people, no vehicles, no signs, no letters.

Thin navy linework across the whole sheet must match the light outline weight of the reference character. Six complete unclipped icons, generous margins, transparent background.
